proposedOperatorData.name: West Coast Surf Shop
proposedOperatorData.tagline: Abersoch surf shop, board/wetsuit hire, and Hell's Mouth surf lessons on the Llŷn Peninsula
proposedOperatorData.description:
West Coast Surf Shop is a surf shop and school based on Lon Pen Cei in Abersoch, on the Llŷn Peninsula in Gwynedd, North Wales. Alongside retail sales of surfboards, wetsuits (Rip Curl, C-Skins, Patagonia), skateboards, and accessories, the business runs equipment hire (surfboards and wetsuits at £15/day or £50/week) and operates the ISA-scripted "Hell's Mouth Surf School," teaching at the nearby Porth Neigwl (Hell's Mouth) beach.

Surf lessons run from May to November, mostly at weekends with daily sessions during school holidays. Two-hour group lessons cost £35 per person and include wetsuit, boots, and board hire; groups are capped at 10 (preferably 8). Private lessons for 1-5 people cost £180 and also include equipment. Participants must be over 8 years old, and under-16s require a parent nearby on the beach.

The shop is open roughly 10:00-16:30 daily in summer, with reduced hours and midweek closures outside the school holidays. Board and wetsuit rentals must be collected before 13:00 and returned by 16:00 for day hires.
proposedOperatorData.uniqueSellingPoint: One of the few dedicated surf shops on the Llŷn Peninsula combining retail, equipment hire, and an ISA-affiliated surf school teaching at Hell's Mouth (Porth Neigwl), a well-known Welsh surf beach.
